title: claoxylon sandwicense var. glabrescens
intro: Claoxylon sandwicense var. glabrescens, commonly known as the "Hawaiian polynesian nettle" or "Hawaiian nettle", is a plant species native to Hawaii. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which aid in the treatment of wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Claoxylon sandwicense var. glabrescens include antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
